summary: First full E2E run of Cazin Čaršija Novosti (portal + CMS). Backend: 23 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_ccn_portal.py, all 23 passing after one test-side fix. They cover auth (httpOnly+Secure cookies, 401 without cookies, brute-force 429 on the 6th try, 2FA QR, logout-all), RBAC workflow (journalist gets 403 on publish, submit, reject needs a reason, approve, publish, visible publicly), author with the extra articles.publish permission, scheduled publishing via the lazy scheduler, versions/restore/duplicate, media upload with webp variants, alt editing, delete returns 409 while in use, ads (sidebar, click 302 + counter, marketing gets 403 on html ads), breaking ticker, cameras CRUD and live HAK images (all 4 return 200), comment moderation, submit-news needs both consents and converts to draft, newsletter consent leaves a pending subscriber, settings/backup/audit, SEO endpoints and share og tags, AI summary (Claude Sonnet 5.5 works), folded diacritics search (Bihać/bihac, čaršiji/carsiji). Frontend (Playwright): the home page shows all widgets (logo, nav, red ticker, hero, latest, cameras, most read, weather, tags, footer, cookie banner). Also checked: article page parts, search, category with subcategories, 404, mobile at 390px (no horizontal overflow, burger menu), /admin redirect to /admin/prijava, login, dashboard, creating a user in the Korisnici dialog, journalist editor flow (save draft, no publish button, submit to review), super-admin reject (window.prompt) / featured image from media library / publish / public view, comment approval UI, home builder (move + hide, then draft preview at /?preview=1 vs live, then publish), ad campaign in the UI shows the OGLAS label and the click redirect URL, settings save, backup download, audit list, 2FA QR, journalist blocked from /admin/korisnici, AI summary in the editor, submit-news form, newsletter widget. One CRITICAL perf bug was found and fixed: /api/media/file blocked the event loop.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: called the synchronous requests-based get_object() inside an async def. Every image request blocked the whole FastAPI event loop; with 3 images in parallel, /api/health took 20s. Home page images stayed grey, networkidle timed out, and the newsletter submit hung on 'Šaljem...'. Fixed with await asyncio.to_thread(get_object, path). Health now 0.08s during image loads, home networkidle 2.3s.

NOT FIXED: these async routes still call the synchronous process_image() / put_object() / get_object() (requests, 60-120s timeouts). Uploads freeze the whole API for every visitor while they run. Wrap them in asyncio.to_thread or use httpx.AsyncClient. init_storage() is sync too.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True: Starlette reflects any Origin with credentials=true. SameSite=Lax limits CSRF, but set explicit origins.
Backup JSON includes the users collection with password_hash and totp_secret (super-admin only, needed for restore). Consider excluding totp_secret or warning in the UI.
Users are soft-deleted, but the email-uniqueness check doesn't filter deleted=True. A deleted user's email can never be reused (400 'Korisnik s tim e-mailom već postoji').

The failed-attempt count is never reset when locked_until expires. After the first lockout, one more wrong password locks the account again for 15 min. Also, the IP-level limit of 20 logins per 5 min (in-memory) is easy to hit on shared IPs.
No ownership/can_edit check: a journalist can duplicate or list the versions of any article, including other people's drafts.
Only checks articles.publish, not can_edit or assigned_categories. An editor limited to some categories can unpublish articles in any category.

Category blocks (Cazin i Krajina, USK, BiH, Region, Svijet, Sport) return 0 articles because of cross-block dedupe when there are few articles (hero 5 + latest 3 = all 8 demo articles), so no category blocks render. Consider allowing repeats or a fallback.
Sessions are never pruned. The profile page lists dozens of active sessions, one per login.

ui_bugs.issue: Flaky, seen once and not reproduced. As super admin: reject an article, pick a featured image, click Save, then click 'Objavi odmah' about 1.5s later. Status stayed 'Odbijeno': audit shows 2 article.update and no transition. Reloading and clicking Publish worked. Possible race in act(): dirty is still true while save is in flight, so it saves twice and the transition is skipped. Please check save()/act() sequencing.
Opening /newsletter with no token only shows 'Nedostaje link.'. There is no subscribe form on that page; the only way to subscribe is the home widget.

issues: Schedule (editor-publish-at) and ad start/end dates use the browser's native datetime-local picker instead of a shadcn Calendar/date-time picker
Reject reason uses window.prompt and the restore confirm uses window.confirm. Use a shadcn Dialog with a textarea
The 4-column grid shows only 3 cards, leaving an empty slot
Big empty area in the left column under the cameras widget, because the category blocks are empty
Raw action keys ('auth.login', 'user.delete') appear in a Bosnian UI. Map them to Bosnian labels
The 'X' share icon is the old Twitter bird

action_items: Move the remaining sync storage/image work in async routes to threads: media upload, crop, submit-news photos, init_storage (HIGH, event loop is blocked)
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' with credentials
Filter deleted users in the create-user email uniqueness check (or free the email on delete)
Reset login_attempts count when the lock expires
Add ownership checks to the duplicate/versions endpoints and can_edit to unpublish/archive
Investigate the editor act()/save race (publish click ignored right after save)
Replace native datetime-local, window.prompt and window.confirm with shadcn components
Make home category blocks render with few articles (dedupe fallback)
critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.media_file: sync requests inside async def (fixed). Same pattern remains in routes_admin.media_upload/crop and routes_public.submit_news
publish_at and scheduler use ISO string comparison; works because both sides are UTC ISO, but a client sending a time without a timezone would be read as UTC
rate_limit is in-memory per process: it resets on restart and isn't shared across workers
Ad click endpoint redirects for inactive or expired campaigns too (no active/date check)
test_credentials: Super admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md works. Test users are created per run with unique emails test_{role}_{run}@example.com / TestPass123! and soft-deleted afterwards.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Cleaned up: test users (soft-deleted), TEST_ articles (soft-deleted), campaigns, cameras, breaking items, comments, the delivered@resend.dev subscriber, test media (force-deleted). Left behind: 3 TEST_ submissions (no delete endpoint; 2 'used', 1 set to 'rejected') and audit log entries. The homepage layout was republished identical to the original. No 2FA was enabled on any account; the super admin was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_ccn_portal.py -n 0 (needs serial mode, shared STATE across classes). Login IP rate limit is 20 per 5 min and is shared by bash and the browser (same egress IP 136.108.30.124); wait about 3 min between full runs. Comment moderation actions are 'approved'/'rejected'/'spam'/'block'/'delete'. Reject in the UI uses window.prompt, so accept the dialog in Playwright. Demo articles have is_demo=True; don't delete them.
rca of the issue: Slow or grey images and hanging requests: /api/media/file was an async def calling services.get_object (requests.get, timeout 60, object storage latency 0.4-8s). That blocks the single uvicorn event loop, so all concurrent API requests queued behind each image fetch (/api/health measured 20s during 3 parallel image loads). Mitigation applied: asyncio.to_thread. Same class of bug remains in the upload/crop/submit-news paths.
